ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: You’ll be able to read QR codes and pay pagoPA notices.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: So that you’ll be able to add deadlines to your calendar and set a reminder.
ios.NSContactsUsageDescription: IO needs access to your contacts to let you add them in calendar events
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: You'll be able to access the app more easily without having to enter the unlock code.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: You’ll be able to save bonuses, certificates and upload screenshots or payment notices.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: IO needs access to the microphone in case you want to leave a voice note
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: You will be able to save pictures from the app to your device.
